scope: Files preferences consumers and native App workflow integration. Real headless AppKit probes use generated documents and an isolated defaults suite. This is not full UI, original factory-default, or whole-product parity proof.

existingNativeFiles.scope: Existing real FSEvents, 5107-file tree, Recovery and encoding regression passed before final drop classification/merge, clear-recent and ready hydration changes. FolderMonitor and Recovery implementations were not changed afterward.

swiftTypecheck.command: xcrun swiftc -swift-version 5 -parse-as-library -typecheck -module-cache-path .cache/swift native/*.swift -framework AppKit -framework WebKit -framework UniformTypeIdentifiers

integration: ReplicaDocumentController is initialized before the application delegate runs. It resolves configured extensions, handles automatic NSDocument recent-entry methods, and uses an app-domain recent list.
New-document NSSavePanel suggestions use effectiveDefaultExtension. Existing document suffixes are retained.

Same-document sidebar switching decodes the target first, uses real NSDocument saving or close review, preserves encoding/BOM and root, clears only old recovery after approval, retains repeat format and disables overwrite.

FileSessionStore persists saved file and folder associations in a separate app-domain snapshot. Restore targets respect explicit opens and recovered documents. Registered file/folder documents are reused.
editorPrefsDidChange triggers a real FolderMonitor preference rescan. Global General flags control close-after-last-window and WebKit inspection.

fileDrop validates native identity and source path, echoes renderer identity, merges supplied paths with only the drag board when requested, classifies real directories before image suffixes, and opens/imports or returns links.
FileImporter creates independent edited Markdown documents; source resources remain read-only and imported media uses its separate persistent lifecycle.

exportPrepare carries an independent invocation Markdown preference snapshot. Renderer beginExport snapshots are preferred, native menu and repeat calls read current native settings. Repeat BASE schema is unchanged.
Initial native hydration precedes document load so recordRecentFiles=false applies before Store.setFile.
FileRecentLocations.clear() clears native recent storage and emits the exact renderer clearRecent command to active document renderers; session snapshots remain separate.

publicInterfaces.FileRecentLocations.clear(): Used by File menu and PreferencesController.
publicInterfaces.MarkdownDocument.beginPreparedExport(_:m: Optional [String:Any] invocation snapshot; nil uses current AppPreferencesStore.
publicInterfaces.MarkdownDocument.switchDocument(to:revie: Default uses real NSDocument close review. Isolated probes inject modal answers without showing sheets.

independentChoices: System close-windows-on-quit policy suppresses restore modes 1 and 2. Mode 3 remains an explicit custom-folder open. Original macOS host behavior for this exact boundary is unproven.

Native Controller recognizes the complete configured multi-dot suffix and still validates text bytes. TS/Swift sidebar filtering retains the statically proven renderer last-extension rule; original macOS multi-dot behavior is unproven.
limitations: Installed Typora macOS factory defaults remain unproven.

Modal Save/Don't Save/Cancel choices in the headless workflow probe are injected. Real saving, failures, document identity, file bytes, recovery and branch commits are exercised. Sheet presentation and native focus need GUI verification.
Original native session restoration order and all close-window interactions are not established by the static preference resource. Current independent session behavior is documented and tested.
The native recent list is app-domain storage behind NSDocumentController virtual methods. Existing previous-build system SharedFileList entries are not migrated.
Markdown import uses managed persistent absolute file URIs for embedded media. Full original import syntax and portable asset relocation remain separate parity work.
Original pixel geometry, sidebar context menus, every shortcut and hidden outline filter remain outside this verification.

cleanup.temporaryNativeFixtures: Removed by TemporaryDirectory after probes exit.
